title: Software Engineering Intern
description: Work with the payments core team on Go and Node.js microservices that process merchant payouts. You will ship production code behind feature flags, write integration tests, and shadow on-call rotations. We look for solid data structures fundamentals and comfort with relational databases.

title: Backend Engineering Intern (Node.js)
description: Join the Zoho Desk platform team building Node.js services for multi-tenant ticket routing. Expect to own small APIs end to end, profile slow queries, and pair with senior engineers on design reviews. Strong JavaScript fundamentals and an interest in distributed systems are what we screen for.

title: AI/ML Research Intern
description: Assist the Computer Vision lab on a DST-funded project detecting crop disease from drone imagery. You will curate datasets, fine-tune PyTorch models on GPU clusters, and co-author an internal technical report. Candidates must have trained at least one deep learning model and be comfortable with Linux and Git.

title: Data Science Intern
description: Work with the demand forecasting pod on predicting order volumes across 500+ dark stores. Day to day you will write pandas pipelines, tune tree-based models, and present findings to category managers. We want someone who can tell a story from a messy table and knows SQL cold.

title: Frontend Intern (React + TypeScript)
description: Build seller-facing dashboards in React and TypeScript for our reseller growth team. You will convert Figma specs into accessible components, add Storybook coverage, and fix real performance regressions measured with Lighthouse. We hire on portfolio quality and clean, typed component design.

title: DevOps Intern
description: Support the Cloud Platform Engineering group automating deployments for internal banking clients. You will maintain Terraform modules, write GitHub Actions pipelines, and troubleshoot Kubernetes rollouts. Linux troubleshooting comfort and a scripting language are essential.

title: Cyber Security Intern
description: Join the Security Operations Centre assisting on SIEM alert triage and vulnerability assessments for enterprise clients. You will run authenticated scans, document findings, and learn incident response playbooks under a mentor. Basic networking knowledge and curiosity about offensive security matter most.

title: Embedded Systems Intern
description: Work with the battery management systems team prototyping firmware for the next scooter platform. You will write embedded C for CAN peripherals, bench-test boards in the lab, and log results in MATLAB. Experience with Arduino or STM32 projects is strongly preferred.

title: Mobile Development Intern (Flutter)
description: Help ship customer-facing Flutter screens for the merchant onboarding flow. You will build reusable widgets, wire them to REST APIs, and squash UI jank using the Flutter DevTools profiler. We look for one or two shipped app projects and careful attention to state management.

title: Full Stack Developer Intern
description: Build internal tools for the customer success org using Next.js on the frontend and FastAPI on the backend. You will own a small internal app end to end, from schema design to deployment on AWS. Expect code review every week and a demo to the leadership team at the end.

title: Data Engineering Intern
description: Work with the supply chain analytics team maintaining Spark pipelines that build daily fulfilment reports. You will model tables in Hive, tune Spark jobs, and add data quality checks for downstream dashboards. We expect SQL fluency and comfort with large distributed datasets.

title: Product Design Intern (UI/UX)
description: Take rough product briefs and turn them into high-fidelity Figma flows for the investing app's learn module. You will run small usability tests with actual users, document decisions, and hand off specs to engineering. We care about craft, clarity of thinking, and a portfolio with real case studies.

title: Machine Learning Intern (NLP)
description: Aid the applied NLP team building Indic-language retrieval for enterprise assistants. You will build RAG evaluation sets, fine-tune embedding models on multilingual corpora, and analyse failure modes. Experience with LangChain-style pipelines and HuggingFace tooling helps a lot.

title: Cloud Engineering Intern (AWS)
description: Work inside an AWS service team building internal tooling for capacity planning. You will write Python automation against internal APIs, contribute to CloudFormation templates, and participate in operational readiness reviews. Strong Linux fundamentals and one scripting language are required.

title: Android Development Intern
description: Join the Android platform team improving app startup time for a 100M+ install app. You will profile cold starts with Macrobenchmark, refactor legacy Kotlin modules, and write instrumentation tests. Applicants should have at least one Android app published or a solid GitHub sample.

title: Frontend Developer Intern
description: Frontend Developer Intern needed for our client dashboard product; you will build React components and fix responsive layout bugs. Selected candidates must pay a refundable security deposit of ₹1,999 for a work laptop, which is returned after the internship completes. Strong HTML, CSS and JavaScript basics required.

title: Data Analytics Intern
description: Analyse sales and marketing datasets and build weekly Power BI dashboards for small business clients. There is a one-time training kit fee of ₹2,499 that covers curated courseware and a certification voucher, payable after selection. Candidates should know Excel and basic SQL.

title: Web Development Intern
description: Looking for a first-year frontend intern with basic React skills to build landing pages for our startup clients. This role comes with a guaranteed PPO of ₹18 LPA at the end of three months. Only 2 seats, so apply immediately if you know HTML, CSS and a little JavaScript.

title: Software Development Intern
description: Work on the Postman API platform team adding tests for the collection runner. You will write TypeScript, improve test coverage, and fix bugs reported by the community. Solid JavaScript fundamentals and familiarity with REST APIs are the main screening criteria.

title: Business Analyst Intern
description: Support the city operations team with dashboards and ad-hoc analysis on restaurant onboarding funnels. You will write SQL queries, build Excel models, and present weekly insights to city managers. Comfort with numbers and clear written communication matter more than prior domain experience.

title: Data Science Intern
description: Join the pricing intelligence team to build models that estimate competitor price movement across categories. You will clean large transaction datasets, tune gradient boosting models, and ship a weekly pricing signal dashboard. Open to third year students with strong SQL and Python.

title: Data Science Intern
description: The pricing intelligence team is looking for a data science intern to support competitor price tracking and category forecasting. Work involves pandas pipelines, model evaluation and a weekly insight readout for category managers. Third year students with solid SQL and Python should apply.

title: ETHIndia 2026 — Student Track
description: A 36-hour hackathon for builders shipping on Ethereum and EVM-compatible chains, with a dedicated student track. Teams get mentors from infrastructure companies and workshops on smart contracts, account abstraction and zero-knowledge proofs. Judging is on technical depth, originality and working demo.

title: Smart India Hackathon 2026 — Software Edition
description: The national flagship hackathon where teams solve problem statements submitted by ministries and PSUs. Shortlisted teams get a 36-hour grand finale at a host institute with mentors from the sponsoring organisation. Winning teams receive cash prizes per problem statement and incubation support.

title: Flipkart GRiD 8.0 — Software Track
description: A multi-round engineering challenge where teams build solutions for e-commerce scale problems like recommendation and inventory routing. Shortlisted teams present to Flipkart engineering leaders in Bengaluru. Winners receive prize money and a pre-placement interview opportunity.

title: Amazon ML Challenge 2026
description: A month-long machine learning competition on a real catalog dataset, open to students across India. Participants submit models scored on a hidden leaderboard and write a short solution report for the final round. Top teams get cash prizes and interview invitations for applied scientist roles.

title: National Coding Championship
description: A 36-hour online coding championship for engineering students with rounds on data structures and web development. Shortlisted participants must DM on Telegram @quickinterns to confirm their slot and receive the problem set. Top 10 entrants get cash prizes and interview referrals.

title: Startup Builders Hackathon
description: A weekend hackathon to build MVPs for early-stage startup ideas with mentorship from founders. Registration happens through the link below and winners get prize money plus a chance to pitch to angel investors. Open to all engineering students with basic web development skills.

title: HackTheFuture 2026
description: URGENT — apply within 2 hours. Limited seats available for this 24-hour AI hackathon, and shortlisted candidates get immediate joining with no interview. Build an agentic AI prototype, submit a demo video, and compete for cash prizes and internship offers.

title: HackVIT 2026
description: A 36-hour hardware and software hackathon hosted on the VIT Vellore campus with tracks in healthtech, fintech and sustainability. Teams of four get mentors from sponsoring companies and access to the electronics lab. Open to second and third year students from any Indian college.

title: ElectroThon 2026
description: A 30-hour hardware hackathon on defence-adjacent electronics with tracks in radar signal processing, embedded firmware and secure communications. Teams build on provided development boards and present to BEL engineers. The top three teams receive prize money and a summer internship interview.

title: ElectroThon 2026
description: BEL's hardware hackathon returns with a 30-hour format on embedded firmware, radar signal processing and secure communication tracks. Development boards and lab access are provided on campus and every team gets a mentor from the engineering group. Cash prizes plus internship interviews for the top teams.

title: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship 2026
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for first year engineering students with a family income under ₹15 lakh. Selected scholars receive up to ₹1,50,000 towards tuition plus a mentorship track with Reliance engineers. Selection is based on Class 12 marks, an aptitude test and a short essay.

title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls 2026
description: AICTE's Pragati scheme supports girl students in AICTE-approved technical institutes with ₹50,000 per year for tuition and books. Applicants must be in the second year with a family income below ₹8 lakh and no other government scholarship. Documents include income certificate, institute bonafide and bank details.

title: Google Generation Scholarship — APAC 2026
description: Google's Generation Scholarship supports third year computer science students who show leadership and a commitment to diversity in tech. Scholars receive ₹75,000, an invite to a Google mentorship programme and interview preparation workshops. Applications need two essays, a resume and a recommendation letter.

title: Tata Capital Pankh Scholarship 2026
description: Pankh supports meritorious students from low-income households pursuing their final year of engineering. The award covers ₹60,000 of academic expenses, paid directly to the institute in two instalments. Shortlisted applicants attend a 20-minute interview with a Tata Capital panel.

title: IISc Young Science Fellowship
description: A research fellowship for first and second year undergraduates who want to spend a summer inside an IISc laboratory. Fellows receive ₹80,000 per year with a ₹20,000 contingency grant and work on a guided research problem. Selection is through an aptitude test and a faculty interview.

title: Infosys Foundation STEM Scholarship
description: The Infosys Foundation STEM Scholarship covers tuition for second year engineering students from rural districts. Recipients get ₹1,00,000 towards fees plus free access to Infosys Springboard certification courses. Selection considers academic record, family income and a statement of purpose.

title: Buddy4Study Merit Scholarship for Engineers
description: A merit scholarship for engineering students from any year with a CGPA of 8.0 or above. The award is a one-time ₹25,000 grant paid to the student's bank account for books and laptop expenses. Applications need marksheets, a college ID and a 200-word statement of purpose.

title: Women in Engineering Fellowship — Qualcomm India
description: Qualcomm India's Women in Engineering fellowship supports third year electronics and computer science students with ₹1,25,000 towards fees and a paid research internship. Fellows are paired with a Qualcomm engineer for a year-long mentoring programme. Selection involves a technical screening and a panel interview.

title: National Merit Scholarship 2026
description: A ₹50,000 merit scholarship for engineering students with a CGPA above 7.5 and family income below ₹6 lakh. Please contact us on WhatsApp only to receive the application form and the document checklist. Last date to submit documents is approaching fast.

title: L&T Build India Scholarship 2026
description: A sponsored M.Tech scholarship for final year civil, mechanical and electrical engineering students, covering full tuition plus a monthly stipend. Selected scholars complete a two-year M.Tech at a partner IIT with a guaranteed placement at L&T. Selection is through a written test and interview.

title: Software Engineer — New Grad (2026 Batch)
description: CRED's new grad software engineer track hires final year students into backend and platform teams. You will ship features for the payments stack, own a service, and go through a structured 12-week onboarding bootcamp. Hiring tests cover DSA, system design basics and a project deep dive.

title: Associate Data Analyst — New Grad
description: Join Navi's analytics team building dashboards and cohort analyses for the lending business. New grads own a metric area from month one, write SQL daily and present insights in weekly business reviews. We look for strong analytical reasoning and comfort with ambiguity.

title: Junior Backend Engineer
description: Work on the order management systems that handle millions of trades a day, primarily in Go with PostgreSQL and Redis. You will write tests, profile latency-sensitive paths and participate in incident reviews. We hire graduate engineers with strong fundamentals regardless of college tier.

title: DevOps Engineer — Entry Level
description: Postman's platform team is hiring an entry level DevOps engineer to maintain build and deploy pipelines for the API client. You will own CI/CD, improve observability dashboards and automate routine infrastructure work. Practical Linux skills and one infrastructure side project are what we screen for.

title: Mobile Engineer (React Native) — New Grad
description: Build customer app experiences in React Native for a services marketplace used across 40+ cities. You will own a feature area, work with design on interaction details, and improve app performance metrics. We want new grads who have shipped at least one mobile project.

title: Rust Systems Engineer — New Grad
description: Atlan is hiring new grads for its data catalog ingestion engine written in Rust. You will write parsers for new data sources, benchmark throughput and contribute to the open-source connectors repository. Strong systems fundamentals and comfort reading large codebases matter most.

title: Work From Home Data Entry Executive
description: A confidential client is hiring work from home data entry executives for a six month contract. Freshers and students from any stream can apply and training will be provided. Contact us on Telegram to receive the joining form and the salary structure.

title: Graduate Engineer Trainee — 2026
description: Bosch's Graduate Engineer Trainee programme rotates new engineers through automotive electronics, manufacturing and quality teams over 18 months. Trainees work on real production lines and complete a Six Sigma certification. Selection is through a campus test, technical interview and HR round.

title: AI Agents Workshop — Build with LangChain
description: A two-day hands-on workshop on building agentic applications with LangChain and open-source LLMs. Participants ship a small RAG-based assistant and get code review from IIIT Hyderabad research scholars. Bring a laptop with Python 3.11 and a HuggingFace account.

title: GDG DevFest Bengaluru 2026
description: DevFest brings 2000+ developers together for a day of talks on Android, cloud and applied machine learning. The student track includes a codelab on building with Gemini APIs and a resume review clinic with hiring partners. Registration is free and seats are allocated by lottery.

title: National Robotics Challenge 2026
description: Teams design and build an autonomous line-following robot plus a robotic arm for a pick-and-place task. IIT Delhi provides the arena, power and mentors while teams bring their own hardware. Top three teams win prize money and a summer internship interview at the Robotics lab.

title: Startup Internship Fair — Bengaluru
description: A one-day hiring fair connecting students with 40+ early-stage startups looking for interns and new grads. Walk-in interviews happen on the spot for candidates who register in advance with their resume. Sessions on resume writing and startup compensation run through the day.

title: Figma Design Systems Masterclass
description: A free three-hour live masterclass on building scalable design systems in Figma with variables, components and tokens. The session includes a live critique of participant files and a take-home component library exercise. Suitable for students who already know the Figma basics.

title: Cybersecurity CTF — Capture the Flag
description: A 12-hour jeopardy-style CTF with challenges in web exploitation, reverse engineering, forensics and cryptography. Beginners get a separate practice track with guided hints, so first-timers are welcome. Teams of up to three; top scorers take home cash prizes and CTF swag.

title: Embedded Systems & IoT Summer School
description: A four-week summer school where students build a sensor-to-cloud pipeline on an ARM Cortex-M board with a LoRa uplink. LTTS engineers teach the hardware modules and review each team's final demo. Accommodation is provided on the Bengaluru campus for outstation students.

title: NASSCOM Product Conclave — Student Pass
description: The student pass gives access to the product management and AI tracks of India's largest product conference. It includes a dedicated mentor hour for final year students and a hiring desk staffed by sponsoring product companies. Application requires a short write-up on a product you would build for Bharat.

title: AI for Bharat Summit — Student Track
description: A student track at the AI for Bharat Summit with sessions on applied ML in agriculture, healthcare and public service delivery. Students get a mentor hour with practitioners and a poster round judged by industry AI leads. Registration is free and travel support is available for outstation shortlisted teams.
stipend_or_prize: Travel grant up to ₹10,000 for shortlisted teams

title: AI for Bharat Summit — Student Track
description: The AI for Bharat Summit student track covers applied machine learning for public service delivery along with a poster showcase judged by industry AI leads. Participants also get a mentor hour and access to the main conference sessions. Free registration with travel support for shortlisted outstation teams.
